class ConfigParserTestCaseNonStandardDefaultSection(ConfigParserTestCase):
    default_section = 'general'


class InterpolationMissingReferenceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """InterpolationMissingOptionError via real get() calls under
    BasicInterpolation and ExtendedInterpolation, with copy and
    pickle-transport verification."""

    def _make_basic_parser(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser()
        cf.read_string(
            "[main]\n"
            "existing = hello\n"
            "missing = %(ref)s\n")
        return cf

    def _make_extended_parser(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cf.read_string(
            "[main]\n"
            "existing = hello\n"
            "missing = ${aux:target}\n"
            "[aux]\n"
            "present = world\n")
        return cf

    def test_basic_missing_reference(self):
        cf = self._make_basic_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as ctx:
            cf.get("main", "missing")
        exc = ctx.exception
        self.assertIs(type(exc),
                      configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(exc.option, "missing")
        self.assertEqual(exc.section, "main")
        self.assertEqual(exc.reference, "ref")
        self.assertEqual(exc.args, ('missing', 'main', '%(ref)s', 'ref'))
        self.assertEqual(cf.get("main", "missing", raw=True), '%(ref)s')
        cf.set("main", "ref", "resolved")
        self.assertEqual(cf.get("main", "missing"), "resolved")

    def test_extended_missing_reference(self):
        cf = self._make_extended_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as ctx:
            cf.get("main", "missing")
        exc = ctx.exception
        self.assertIs(type(exc),
                      configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(exc.option, "missing")
        self.assertEqual(exc.section, "main")
        self.assertEqual(exc.reference, "aux:target")
        self.assertEqual(exc.args, ('missing', 'main',
                                   '${aux:target}', 'aux:target'))
        self.assertEqual(cf.get("main", "missing", raw=True),
                         '${aux:target}')
        cf.set("aux", "target", "resolved")
        self.assertEqual(cf.get("main", "missing"), "resolved")

    def test_extended_missing_cross_section(self):
        cf = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        cf.read_string("[alpha]\nkey = ${beta:absent}\n")
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as ctx:
            cf.get("alpha", "key")
        exc = ctx.exception
        self.assertIs(type(exc),
                      configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(exc.option, "key")
        self.assertEqual(exc.section, "alpha")
        self.assertEqual(exc.reference, "beta:absent")
        self.assertEqual(exc.args, ('key', 'alpha', '${beta:absent}',
                                   'beta:absent'))
        self.assertEqual(cf.get("alpha", "key", raw=True), '${beta:absent}')
        cf.add_section("beta")
        cf.set("beta", "absent", "cross-resolved")
        self.assertEqual(cf.get("alpha", "key"), "cross-resolved")

    def _check_transport(self, exc):
        for label, cloned in [
            ("shallow", copy.copy(exc)),
            ("deep", copy.deepcopy(exc)),
        ]:
            self.assertIs(type(cloned), type(exc), label)
            self.assertEqual(cloned.args, exc.args, label)
            self.assertEqual(cloned.option, exc.option, label)
            self.assertEqual(cloned.section, exc.section, label)
            self.assertEqual(cloned.reference, exc.reference, label)
        for protocol in range(pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
            data = pickle.dumps(exc, protocol)
            restored = pickle.loads(data)
            self.assertIs(type(restored), type(exc),
                          "pickle protocol %d" % protocol)
            self.assertEqual(restored.args, exc.args,
                             "pickle protocol %d" % protocol)
            self.assertEqual(restored.option, exc.option,
                             "pickle protocol %d" % protocol)
            self.assertEqual(restored.section, exc.section,
                             "pickle protocol %d" % protocol)
            self.assertEqual(restored.reference, exc.reference,
                             "pickle protocol %d" % protocol)

    def test_basic_missing_reference_transport(self):
        cf = self._make_basic_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as ctx:
            cf.get("main", "missing")
        self._check_transport(ctx.exception)

    def test_extended_missing_reference_transport(self):
        cf = self._make_extended_parser()
        with self.assertRaises(
                configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) as ctx:
            cf.get("main", "missing")
        self._check_transport(ctx.exception)
